_about: One table for the refused operator settings' env spellings. Read by the Go test (cutover.TestRefusedOperatorPaths_EnvCells, over RefusedOperatorPaths) and by the Python test (scripts/tests/test_deploy_env_check.py, over the generated deploy/retired-env-names.txt), so the two matchers cannot drift apart. refused: true means the name is refused as set; false means it must not be.

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_BASE_URL
cells.why: the old openai path, spelled directly

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_BASE_URL_FILE
cells.why: core reads NAME_FILE as NAME (env.go resolve), so this reached the retired path on main

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_HARDCOVER_CREDENTIALS_API_TOKEN
cells.why: the credentials family, a plain id and key

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_HARDCOVER_CREDENTIALS_API_TOKEN_FILE
cells.why: the family, NAME_FILE form

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_GOOGLE_BOOKS_CREDENTIALS_API_KEY
cells.why: the family with a hyphenated source id (core reads GOOGLE_BOOKS as google-books)

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_GOOGLE_BOOKS_CREDENTIALS_API_KEY_FILE
cells.why: the family, hyphenated id, NAME_FILE form

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_X_CREDENTIALS_Y
cells.why: one character on each side of each star is enough

cells.name: XABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_BASE_URL
cells.why: a prefix: the pattern is anchored at the start (mutant: envGlob unanchored)

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_BASE_URL_FOO
cells.why: a suffix other than _FILE: the pattern is anchored at the end (mutant: envGlob unanchored)

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_BASE_URL_FILEX
cells.why: _FILE must be the whole suffix

cells.name: abo_integrations_ai_openai_base_url
cells.why: core reads capitals only (env.go exactUpperName)

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_URL
cells.why: the setting to use

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_AI_OPENAI_URL_FILE
cells.why: the setting to use, NAME_FILE form

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA__CREDENTIALS_API_KEY
cells.why: an empty left side of the family's first star (mutant: .+ widened to .*)

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_HARDCOVER_CREDENTIALS_
cells.why: an empty right side of the family's second star (mutant: .+ widened to .*)

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_CREDENTIALS_API_KEY
cells.why: no source id at all

cells.name: XABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_HARDCOVER_CREDENTIALS_API_TOKEN
cells.why: a prefix on the family

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_HARDCOVER_API_TOKEN
cells.why: the declared four-segment secret, still a passthrough secret

cells.name: ABO_INTEGRATIONS_METADATA_GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY_FILE
cells.why: the declared secret, NAME_FILE form

cells.name: _FILE
cells.why: nothing before the suffix
